test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 14 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Which of the given statements related to the temples of India is correct?

I. The Nagara style of architecture is also known as the North Indian style

II. The Dravidian style of architecture is also known as the South Indian style.
solution:
The correct answer is__** Both I and II.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **​The Nagara fashion **of temple structure that became popular in northern India is known as Nagara.
 
• **The Gupta Dynasty (3rd century CE to 543 CE)** turned into the first documented purchaser of the Nagara fashion, which remained popular throughout northern India till Muslim conquests in the **13th century CE.**
 
• The Pallavas started their rule in the** 4th century A.D. Mahendravarman I (advert 571-630**) became the first king of the Pallavas.
 
• The Pallavas laid the inspiration for the Dravidian structure.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Pallavas** were the first to construct temples in the Dravida style.
 
• **Kandariya Mahadev Temple** in Madhya Pradesh is a conventional example of the Nagara-style temple architecture
 
• The actual term Dravidian turned into first hired by means of **Robert A. Caldwell.**
